findings.body: The revised retention rule is bypassed by the earlier finished-work cleanup. `_finished` (doctor.py:120–142) includes `fix/forge-files` when GitHub reports a MERGED or CLOSED pull request at its head and the worktree is clean or contains only permitted leftovers. Lines 381–387 then remove its folder and branch before this call reaches `_in_fix`'s existing-branch guard. Closing a doctor's repair pull request without merging therefore lets the next `doctor --fix` delete that fix and create another; a merged fix is also automatically deleted. This is new evidence from the general cleanup path, distinct from the failed-repair cleanup superseded by the coordinator's retention ruling. Exclude doctor's fixed branch from that cleanup and cover both CLOSED and MERGED cases through the real command.
findings.title: Not done: doctor never removes its own fix
